summary: Russia launched mass drone and missile strikes on Kyiv killing 5 and wounding 20+, hit a 24-story residential building in Darnytskyi district, and struck the 'We are Ukraine' TV building. The 'North' group captured Ozernoye in Kharkiv region. Russia plans new ballistic missiles with 800km range by end 2026. Multi-axis aerial attacks continue across northern, eastern, and southern fronts.

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting a multi-axis aerial campaign using Shahed drones, guided aerial bombs, and developing 800km-range ballistic missiles. Kyiv faces repeated drone attacks from the north (Chernihiv direction) and south. Eastern and southern fronts see intensive guided bomb and drone strikes on Donetsk, Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, and Sumy. Civilian infrastructure and logistics remain high-priority targets. The threat of escalation via new ballistic missile deployment by end 2026 is significant.
sections.regional_response: EU authorized €3.2B Patriot missile purchase via €90B loan exception at Ukraine's request; Britain allocated $135M specifically for Patriot by winter. Germany may share military-age male residence permit data with Ukraine for recruitment. Ukraine showcased new rocket systems at MSPO-2026 in Poland. Kyiv region shortened curfew to 01:00-05:00. EU disbursement of €90B will occur over 2 years, not accelerated.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russia arrested a Kuban resident for attempting to join a Ukrainian military formation; former MoD personnel chief Kuznetsov bribery case concluded. Russia continues prisoner exchange with Ukraine at highest US level. Peskov noted European gas storage cannot be filled before winter even at maximum pumping. Zakharova framed Western involvement as direct complicity. Russia views Leipzig drone incident as pre-planned escalation.
